label: Identity
description: Who a directory said a credential belongs to: a stable subject, a display name, the groups it belongs to, and -- when verify was given a `type` -- whatever else the directory said about the account, under `attributes`. The same whatever the directory, so one sign-in graph fits them all. `attributes` is not declared as a field here because a shape may not name a contract variable (L001); the value is there, and a sign-in reads it through the shape its own port returns.
